d.ko: During lunch one day, Toomi Yuna meets two "Kindred Spirits" on the roof of her school. When they insist she help them nurture young love, Yuna finds herself playing "yuri cupid" to six unique and adorable couples. Can she remain aloof or will the promise of a "yuritopia" reach her too?

d.zh: 某日午餐时分，远见由奈在学校天台邂逅了两位“百合灵”。在她们的坚持下，由奈不得不答应帮助她们促成少女们的恋情。期间，由奈发现自己成为了六对独特且可爱的情侣的“百合丘比特”。她是会冷静旁观，还是会加入这个“百合天国”？
